record.label: Oracle kappa state-versus-map probe
record.summary: SOLVED - verdict STATE, mechanism KAPPA4 PUSH LOSS: at 8M-sample MC precision across three networks, the model's kappa3 diagonal is accurate and flat through layer 6 (median unit ratios 0.97-1.00) while kappa4 starts EXACT at layer 2 (0.999-1.016 - the emission is right) and decays about 7 percent per layer (0.93, 0.85-0.87, 0.78-0.80, 0.72-0.75 at layers 3-6), classification push_loss_decay in every network. Compounded to depth 15 the deep kappa4 runs at 40-50 percent of truth. Substituting oracle cumulants at layers 2-6 improves the mean at every layer. The raw-MSE lane's named target: find and carry the kappa4 channel the push loses (successor A6A adjudicates CP4 dropped-plane mass versus un-carried generic-kappa4 content by measuring the same ratios on a cap-8192 variant and the carrier estimator).
record.terminal_criterion: STATE|MAP|MIXED verdict with shrink percentages at 8M samples.
